name: Vestment of Peace
body:
School illusion (glamer) [good]; Level bard 3, cleric 3, oracle 3, warpriest 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour/level

DESCRIPTION

Your clothing and armor shift to pristine shades of white and gold, radiating a gentle, hypnotic warmth. You gain a +1 sacred bonus on Diplomacy checks for every three caster levels (minimum +1, maximum +5). Furthermore, you can use Diplomacy to change a creature’s attitude as a full-round action instead of taking 1 minute, though doing so incurs a -5 penalty on the check.

The true power of the spell lies in its ability to calm active hostility. When a combat encounter begins but before initiative is rolled, you can raise your hands and speak a word of peace as an immediate action, discharging the spell. All creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a Will saving throw. If they fail, they cannot take hostile actions for 1 round per caster level (maximum 5 rounds), or until they or their allies are attacked.
